endorsements.quote: Every agent must be resolved into exactly one coalition, any agent that has not converged is dramatically routed to escalate to human rather than dropped or silently resolved by default (Fig. 2).

This parameter should be determined and periodically revised by an appropriate hospital clinical ethics, AI governance, or clinical oversight committee, with consideration of patient safety, accountability, workflow, and trust.

unlisted_practices: Set the stopping rule for multi-agent deliberation by a clinical team based on case clinical urgency, with shorter deliberation and earlier clinician escalation for urgent or high-risk cases.
Conduct systematic bias auditing of multi-agent AI systems, including reputation-weighting mechanisms, before real-world deployment.
Present escalations from multi-agent AI to clinicians in a form they can quickly interpret and act on, triaged by acuity and confidence margin to limit alert fatigue.
Require explicit justification and structured review before one AI agent can override another agent in multi-agent clinical decision support.

screen.reason: The paper designs and tests a multi-agent negotiation guardrail framework (MC3G) featuring reputation weighting and mandatory escalation to humans, comparing it empirically via simulation against baseline voting to measure silent failure and escalation rates.

primary.practice: mandatory human escalation safety valve in multi-agent consensus
